population_scope: international: answers are read from 'Admission for foreign applicants' (/en/inc-academ) and the foreign-citizen scholarship page; the domestic route (UNT threshold, AET, state grants, KZT price list) is kept in notes only.

english.notes: No minimum score for international degree applicants. /en/inc-academ lists 'If available, IELTS/TOEFEL IBT/TOEFL ITP/APTIS/Duolingo English testing/ Interpress certificate (copy)' and asks for 'Proof of a B2-level knowledge of English (if any)' - optional, no figure. IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL iBT 46 on /en/scholarship-foreign is the state scholarship's language bar, not the admission minimum. 6.0 IELTS on /en/academic-mobility-foreign-citizens is for exchange students only.

gpa.notes: No grade threshold published for international applicants (online application with diploma and transcript, then an online interview). The programme page's 'Threshold Score (Grant): 100.' is the UNT score for the domestic state-grant competition, not an international criterion.

deadline.notes: International round in prose only: 'Astana IT University opens calls for applications in March and stops in late August' (/en/inc-academ) - no date, no year. Dated deadlines on /en/how-to-apply (June 20 - August 25, originals by August 24) and /en/student-grants (July 25, 2026) are the domestic 2026 cycle.

tuition.notes: 'Bachelor Studies' block of 'Admission for foreign applicants'; academic year not printed (the fee-year rule will make it unknown). Domestic price list on /en/bachelor: 'Bachelor’s Degree 2.500.000₸' for the 2026-2027 academic year (KZT, not the international figure). Accommodation $70/month.

value.name: Scholarship Program of the Republic of Kazakhstan for foreign citizens (operator: Bolashak Centre for International Programmes)

scholarship_exists.quote: Applicants who are foreign citizens, including persons of Kazakh nationality who are not citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan, may apply for the Scholarship Program of the Republic of Kazakhstan to study under bachelor and master programs.
scholarship_exists.notes: Government-funded, competitive (Study in Kazakhstan portal registration, online test, interview). Covers 'Full cost of tuition fee' and a 'Monthly allowance, depending on the academic progress'; does not cover travel, accommodation, visa or medical insurance (scholarship-audit class: FULL_TUITION). 490 bachelor grants for foreign students in 2026-2027. Application period 'March 30 - May 31' with no year printed. AITU's own discounts for fee-paying students are in a regulations PDF, not audited.

scholarship_international.quote: Applicants who are foreign citizens, including persons of Kazakh nationality who are not citizens of the Republic of Kazakhstan, may apply for the Scholarship Program of the Republic of Kazakhstan to study under bachelor and master programs.
scholarship_international.notes: Open to foreign citizens only (a Kazakh citizen is domestic and competes for state educational grants instead).
